decisions.rationale: Lead Mega Charizard Y plus Venusaur establishes immediate sun pressure: Chlorophyll Sleep Powder and Heat Wave/Solar Beam punish most likely leads. reflections.summary: Won because Mega Charizard Y plus Venusaur matched their chosen four well: Sleep Powder removed Sneasler and Weavile’s early pressure, while Charizard eliminated Skarmory and cleaned Mega Venusaur/Weavile. The Charizard-Y/Venusaur bring and Charizard Mega choice were appropriate.
reflections.adjustment: Keep the Charizard-Y/Venusaur core if they show this structure again, but do not click Sleep Powder into Mega Venusaur; target it directly with Heat Wave or Sludge Bomb while respecting Sneasler Rock Slide and Weavile priority.
reflections.notebook: Game 1 selection was Sneasler/Weavile/Mega Venusaur/Skarmory, leaving Incineroar and Gardevoir out. Sneasler carries Life Orb Rock Slide and can threaten Charizard; Weavile has Focus Sash, Pressure, and Ice Shard. Mega Venusaur is immune to Sleep Powder and has Sludge Bomb/Earth Power. Charizard Y is a strong Mega choice into this revealed four; retain Kingambit as the main Mega Gardevoir contingency and Raichu as disruption support.
